pr.title: Block direct git push in concurrent mode, require consensus protocol
pr.description:
Adds gateway-level enforcement that blocks direct `git push` in concurrent/BRC mode.
Agents must use `egg-orch consensus propose --push` to push changes, ensuring all
modifications go through the BRC peer review protocol. Introduces a `consensus_push`
marker that flows from orch_cli through the git wrapper to the gateway.
pr.test_plan:
- Automated: gateway/tests/test_concurrent_push_block.py covers all enforcement scenarios
- Manual: Deploy to a test pipeline in concurrent mode and verify that direct push is blocked while consensus propose --push succeeds

Pre-merge: None
Post-merge: Verify existing concurrent pipelines still function correctly with the new enforcement
